The '''Skirmish at the Hidden Jedi Temple''' was an incident taking place during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] in [[137 ABY]]. A group of [[Imperial Knight]]s fought with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] in their [[Hidden Temple]].

==Prelude==
Having witnessed the [[Massacre of New Coral City|massacre on Mon Calamari]] and an [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] patrol nearly killing his extended family, [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]] decided that the only way to end everything and for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to leave him alone, was to kill [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]].

==Skirmish==
Upon arrival at the Temple, Cade was surprised to see [[Imperial Knight]]s, [[Marasiah Fel]], [[Antares Draco]], and [[Ganner Krieg]]. He and [[Shado Vao]] immediately engaged the latter two. He ended the skirmish by [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushing]] the two.
